description: List the API key's webhook subscriptions (Streaming Lite tier and up; other tiers get a 403 with an upgrade URL). Read-only: signing secrets are always masked, and this server deliberately has no create/update/delete tools — manage subscriptions via the REST API or SDKs. Each row shows url, subscribed events (line_movement, resolution, steam, market_suspended), filters and active status. Use this first to find the webhook id for propline_get_webhook_deliveries.
name: propline_list_webhooks
title: List webhooks
